answer: Whisper relays stop clones. An agent posts a 60-credit bond for one relay key; each epoch it passes a whisper through three relays with a fresh nonce. Each relay inks its pigment seal by the zenith deadline. Auditors replay it: missing pigment, reused seal, late whisper burns it. Fees start 25, the k-th 25+9(k-1); 1,000 clones pay 4,520,500 plus 60,000 bonds vs a 40,000 pool. Rented relays fail: one seal per key. Honest agents pay 25 once.
